messaging.list.empty_state.context: Empty-state message in the personal-messages list.

messaging.list.read_tooltip.context: Tooltip on the envelope icon of a read inbox message.

messaging.list.mark_read_label.context: aria-label on the mark-as-read button for an unread inbox message.

messaging.list.read_by_recipient_tooltip.context: Tooltip on a sent message's status icon once the recipient has read it.

messaging.list.delivered_tooltip.context: Tooltip on a sent message's status icon while it's delivered but not yet read.

messaging.list.system_sender_fallback.context: Fallback sender display name when a message has no human sender.

messaging.list.from_label.context: Sender label on an inbox message card.

messaging.list.unknown_recipient_fallbac.context: Fallback recipient display name on a sent message card.

messaging.list.to_label.context: Recipient label on a sent message card.

messaging.list.delete_label.context: aria-label on the delete button for an inbox message.

messaging.delete_confirm.title.context: showConfirm() dialog title for deleting a personal message.

messaging.delete_confirm.message.en: Are you sure you want to delete this message?
messaging.delete_confirm.message.context: showConfirm() dialog body for deleting a personal message.

messaging.popover.loading.context: Loading placeholder in the topbar messages popover, byte-identical to common.status.loading.

messaging.popover.auth_required.context: Error shown in the messages popover when there is no valid session (note: no trailing period, unlike the near-identical string used in dept-dashboard.js).

messaging.popover.empty.context: Empty-state message in the messages popover. Byte-identical string is reused in the combined notifications popover (static/js/app-renderers.js:1100), which mixes unread mandatory-readings and recent news, not just messages — a human should decide if these need separate keys since the underlying content differs even though the copy is identical.

messaging.popover.load_failed.context: Error message in the messages popover when the fetch fails. Byte-identical string repeats in the combined notifications popover (static/js/app-renderers.js:1140).
